videos.script: Quitanda's product pages ask the database for the same few hundred products all day. {{pages}} A cache keeps a copy of those answers in memory. Most requests then never reach the database. ElastiCache is that cache, run by AWS. You choose the machines, or with Serverless you choose none. {{engines}} moto will record a cache cluster for you. It runs no cache behind it. So this lesson starts a real one on your own computer, the Redis server Ubuntu ships. {{redis}} You will write the usual pattern in Python. Ask the cache first. On a miss, ask the database and keep the answer for five minutes. {{aside}} Then you will break it. A price changes in the database, and the page goes on showing the old one. {{stale}} You will fill the cache to its limit and watch three settings decide what it throws away. {{evict}} And you will send fifty requests at one missing key, and count the queries that reach the database. {{herd}}
